name: cyber-crime-portal
description: Cyber Crime Portal - Full Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../Frontend && npm install
scripts.start:dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd Frontend && npm start"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend

author: Shubham Bhojane, Vinanti Bendure, Darshan Seleke, Chaitrali Karale
